events.verdict: After communicating with the Replay Center, it is confirmed that Morant (MEM) does not release his shot attempt prior to the expiration of the shot clock.
Plumlee (PHX) establishes himself in a wide screening position, tripping Stevens (MEM) during the screen.

Allen (PHX) maintains a forearm against Pippen Jr.'s (MEM) body during the drive to the basket. He lowers his arm as Pippen Jr. begins his shooting motion, but the contact with his lower body is marginal.
Bagley III (MEM) moves laterally into Booker (PHX) and initiates body contact before he enters his shooting motion, affecting his SQBR.
Pippen Jr. (MEM) moves alongside Booker (PHX) during his drive to the basket and the body contact is marginal before he cleanly dislodges the ball.
Stevens (MEM) and Durant (PHX) briefly engage and disengage during the throw-in.
O'Neale (PHX) places a hand on Morant's (MEM) side and immediately removes it as he begins his shooting motion.
Pippen Jr. (MEM) steps into Booker (PHX) as he runs towards the basket for the rebound and the contact is marginal.
Allen (PHX) commits a take foul on Morant (MEM).
Allen (PHX) commits a take foul on Spencer (MEM).

events.verdict: Bane's (MEM) pass goes off of Pippen Jr.'s (MEM) hands and out of bounds. Allen (PHX) never makes any contact with the ball.
